info.prompt: A high-angle shot of a {7x7|8x8|9x9} hexagonal Farkle Frenzy board erupting in mid-chain: selected tiles {float|pulse|orbit} in perfect alignment, their gemstone faces ({ruby 1|sapphire 2|emerald 3|topaz 4|steel 5|amethyst 6}) emitting concentric glow rings, Stone Blockers taking damage with granite particle effects, a Rainbow Bomb detonating in slow-motion prismatic shards that freeze-frame to reveal the scoring combo (Three Pairs: 1500pts) in hovering neon numerals before cascading into the vault below.
